items.title: Move from sequence to a usable structural hypothesis
items.situation: A reliable structure is missing, blocking construct and site decisions.
items.approach: Submit a sequence or existing structure to predict monomers and complexes with key regions highlighted.
items.outcome: Reviewable structures, confidence cues, and a starting point for design.

items.title: Improve the binding performance of a lead
items.situation: A lead is active, but affinity improvement has become expensive trial and error.
items.approach: Generate focused mutation sets around the interface and rank them with consistent criteria.
items.outcome: A prioritized candidate list, key sites, and design rationale.

items.title: Improve expression, stability, and developability
items.situation: An active molecule falls short on expression, thermal stability, or aggregation.
items.approach: Explore more robust sequences while preserving functional regions.
items.outcome: Constraint-aware designs with explicit risk cues.

items.title: Generate binders for a new target
items.situation: No usable lead exists and candidates must begin at the target interface.
items.approach: Generate, screen, and interpret new sequences from the target structure and constraints.
items.outcome: Diverse candidates, ranking rationale, and export-ready sequences.

tasks.title: Improve candidate binding
tasks.brief: A lead exists, but affinity has stalled
tasks.situation: Your lead is active, but further affinity gains have become expensive trial and error: structure limits mutable regions, and the combination space is too large to exhaust.
tasks.approach: Identify key binding-interface residues, generate a small set of informative mutation combinations, and provide consistent ranking and explanations.
tasks.outcome: An experiment-ready candidate list, showing what changed in each candidate and why.
tasks.mediaTodo: 替换为亲和力优化的真实操作录屏

tasks.title: Improve expression, stability and developability
tasks.brief: Activity is good; manufacturing is not
tasks.situation: Activity meets your target, but low expression, poor thermal stability or aggregation blocks process and formulation development.
tasks.approach: Explore more robust sequences while preserving functional regions, and assess the impact of changes on activity.
tasks.outcome: Modification proposals that respect functional constraints, with risk warnings to avoid trading activity for stability.
tasks.mediaTodo: 替换为稳定性改造的真实操作录屏

tasks.title: Generate binders for a new target
tasks.situation: The target is new, with no known binder to improve. Candidates must start from structural interface features; conventional routes rely on phage display or chance.
tasks.approach: Generate new sequences from target structures and design constraints, then screen and provide explainable rankings.
tasks.outcome: A diverse set of candidate sequences ready for synthesis and validation.
tasks.mediaTodo: 替换为从头设计的真实操作录屏

tasks.title: Assess structures and complexes from sequences
tasks.brief: Without a reliable structure, work is blocked
tasks.situation: Without a reliable structure, experiment design and residue decisions lack a foundation. Co-crystal work is slow, and homologous templates are not close enough.
tasks.approach: Submit sequences or existing structures, predict monomers and complexes, and highlight key regions.
tasks.outcome: Inspectable structures with confidence indicators, providing a starting point for subsequent design.

headline.text: Across 12 targets, with no more than 50 candidates tested per target under low-throughput conditions, target success exceeded 90%.

cases.result: Lead antibody affinity improved 23-fold, with specificity unchanged
cases.difficulty: CDR structure constrains mutable regions; over 10⁶ combinations require more than 4 rounds of conventional saturation-mutagenesis screening

cases.result: Industrial enzyme Tm increased by 11.4°C; residual activity at 60°C rose from 31% to 86%
cases.difficulty: Thermal stability must improve without sacrificing catalytic efficiency; the two often trade off

cases.result: Antibody–antigen interface DockQ reached 0.78; 14 of 16 key contact residues matched
cases.difficulty: No co-crystal structure was available; homologous templates shared less than 40% sequence identity

cases.result: 48 candidates for a new target yielded 5 wet-lab binding signals; the best KD was 42 nM
cases.difficulty: No known binders or usable leads; candidates must start from interface features

cases.result: Nanobody aggregation propensity decreased by 62%, with neutralizing activity retained
cases.difficulty: A hydrophobic patch near the CDR makes binding sensitive to modification

cases.result: Therapeutic protein degradation slowed 3.8-fold in accelerated testing at 40°C
cases.difficulty: Expression-host compatibility and formulation conditions must both be considered; single mutations offer limited benefit

models.name: NewOrigin (Darwin)
models.limitation: Representation quality decreases for orphan proteins without homologous information; cross-species transfer needs calibration with experimental data.

models.name: MMFold
models.limitation: Confidence is lower for highly flexible and disordered regions; conformations dependent on cofactors or specific pH require consideration of experimental conditions.

models.name: MMDesign
models.limitation: Expression and developability of generated sequences require staged experimental validation; de novo designs longer than 200 amino acids have substantially lower success rates.
